findings: DeleteParentGroup tries success, client error, then server error. Its client error parser requires one error child and correlated id/from/type=error, then tries BadRequest, NotAuthorized, ItemNotFound and RateOverlimit in order. The RateOverlimit dependency requires tag error, text rate-overlimit and integer code 429.

Create IQ named-subject/parent-only projection remains supported: makeCreateRequest composes the create node with namedSubjectOrUnnamedSubjectFallbackMixinGroupArgs. Named subject is mandatory in that branch; parentArgs is an optional child; hasParentGroupDefaultMembershipApprovalMode invokes optionalMerge for any non-null value, including false, and writes default_membership_approval_mode=request_required.
